es: Ingesta adecuada de potasio: hombres adultos 3.400 mg/día y mujeres adultas 2.600 mg/día; embarazo 2.900 mg/día y lactancia 2.800 mg/día (19–50 años).
Estos valores se refieren a ingesta total y NO a dosis de suplemento; no se aplican a personas con eliminación renal alterada o medicamentos que dificultan eliminar potasio.
El etiquetado estadounidense declara potasio elemental, no la masa de la sal; el límite frecuente de 99 mg por suplemento en EE. UU. no constituye una norma argentina.
en: Potassium AI: adult men 3,400 mg/day and women 2,600 mg/day; pregnancy 2,900 mg/day and lactation 2,800 mg/day (ages 19–50).
These are total intake reference values, NOT supplement doses; they do not apply to people with impaired potassium excretion or medications that impair excretion.
US supplement labels list elemental potassium rather than salt mass; the common US 99 mg supplement amount is not an Argentine regulatory rule.
it: AI del potassio: uomini adulti 3.400 mg/die e donne 2.600 mg/die; gravidanza 2.900 mg/die e allattamento 2.800 mg/die (19–50 anni).
Sono valori di assunzione totale, NON dosi di integratore; non valgono in caso di ridotta escrezione renale o farmaci che la compromettono.
Le etichette USA indicano il potassio elementare, non la massa del sale; i comuni 99 mg negli integratori USA non sono una norma argentina.

sources.claim: A dietary supplement requires product registration (RNPA), labeling and warnings; ingredient name alone does not establish market authorization.
RNE and RNPA must be checked on the specific product packaging.
UL applies to total intake for many nutrients, but for folate, magnesium, niacin and vitamin E it applies only to specified supplemental or fortified sources; vitamin A UL is form-specific.
Multivitamin composition varies; some products provide small quantities of calcium, magnesium and potassium, and products should be chosen by age/life stage.
